name: AdSpec validates current configuration and invalidates old approval
description: Exercises AdSpec through approval, input change, error recovery and export using current data.
steps: Open #/windly. Select 검수 통과 예시 in 검수 시나리오, then click 예시 불러오기.
Click 현재 명세 로컬 승인. Change 일예산 to 30001 and verify 재승인 필요; refresh and verify budget 30001 remains.
Expand 전체 JSON 편집 and replace the JSON with {. Verify JSON 오류 and disabled current report save. Restore 검수 통과 예시 through the scenario picker.
Save the current report, then use JSON 파일 가져오기 to upload a local JSON file containing {} and verify invalid input rather than approval.
Restore 검수 통과 예시 again. Open the regression section and run the fixture regression action.
expected: Approval is invalidated by input changes; edited inputs persist after reload. Invalid JSON and {} cannot approve or claim readiness. Valid report downloads and the 11 regression fixture expectations pass.

name: FlowMap approval, replay prevention and traceable evidence
description: Checks workflow execution stays within the current approved input and exposes a useful report and context.
steps: From #/ choose FlowMap. Restore 표준 흐름 복원 then click 검증하고 실행.
Verify approval wait, then click 현재 내용 승인하고 실행. Run again and verify replay does not add another delivered record.
Download 실행 보고서 Markdown. Choose 장비 ID 누락 in 실습 시나리오, execute and verify visible validation failure.
Change 주간 요청 수 in the assumption model and verify the calculated weekly time changes with its stated formula.
Use 과제와 설계 then 검증과 출처. Verify official source links and download 설명서 내려받기, then return to 직접 사용하기.
expected: The approved standard workflow records one local delivery and replay adds none. Missing equipment blocks execution. Editable assumptions change the transparent estimate. Current reports and source-backed explanatory Markdown download.

name: Structured briefs and agent traces expose current validation evidence
description: Checks structured requirements and agent execution records produce reviewable, input-bound evidence.
steps: Open #/docenty, choose the complete review-ready sample in 시나리오 and click 선택한 예시 불러오기. Verify 9 checks pass.
Enter 검수자 in 검토 기록의 작성자 and click 현재 기준 검토 완료. Change 제품 제목 and verify 재검사 필요 and disabled 검사 근거 JSON.
Click 검사 실행 and download 브리프 Markdown and 검사 근거 JSON.
Open #/ensapia. With the initial scenario inspect 기준 기록 failure, switch to 후보 기록 and verify 범위 내 통과. Click an event to inspect its finding evidence.
Open JSON 직접 편집 and replace the candidate JSON with {. Verify 입력 오류 and disabled 비교 보고서 내려받기. Click 선택 예제로 초기화 then download the comparison report.
expected: Complete brief passes9 checks; changing it invalidates review and stale evidence export. Re-execution creates current documents. AvatarOps compares the same synthetic scenario, exposes event evidence, rejects invalid JSON and restores working report export after reset.

name: StockBridge reconciles uploaded CSV and protects stale review on mobile
description: Uses an actual small CSV to confirm correct arithmetic, error handling and review invalidation on a narrow screen.
steps: Open #/vibers at the mobile viewport. Initial sample should show7 data rows and4 unique records, USD17 and EUR55.5. Inspect a discrepancy with 근거 보기.
Upload a CSV named stock-check.csv with content: sku,region,expected_qty,counted_qty,unit_cost,currency\nTEST-1,US,10,8,2.50,USD\nTEST-2,KR,5,5,1000,KRW . Check CSV 열 연결 and click 대사 실행.
Verify2 unique records and USD5 discrepancy. Enter 검수자 and mark 현재 대사 검토 완료, then download 행별 결과 CSV and 대사 근거 JSON.
Edit counted_qty for TEST-1 from8 to9 in CSV 직접 편집. Verify prior review is invalid and downloads are disabled until 대사 실행; rerun and verify USD2.5.
Select 누락·중복·수량 차이가 있는 파일 and load it; confirm invalid records remain excluded. Navigate the mobile 검증과 출처 tab.
expected: Uploaded content is actually parsed and maps to2 unique records. Review and exports bind current CSV; the edited discrepancy becomes USD2.5 after rerun. Invalid/duplicate rows are excluded and origin evidence remains available. Mobile controls and navigation are usable without page overflow.

name: FaultLab reproduces defects and verifies fixes on mobile
description: Checks real faulty and corrected functions against the same separate oracle and exports only an observed defect.
steps: Open #/wisewires and use the all-scenarios run button with the default inputs. Verify6 reproduced defects and6 fixed passes.
Select the discount scenario. Compare 결함 포함 and 수정 적용: default payable should be -4000 and0. Download 재현 보고서 Markdown.
Set coupon/할인 amount to500. Verify the old result disappears, run the comparison again and confirm both variants pass and defect-report export is disabled.
Clear a numeric input, rerun and verify visible input errors without a PASS claim. Restore 현재 샘플 복원 and rerun to recover.
expected: The six seeded faulty functions violate independent rules while corrected functions pass. Valid discount500 does not invent a defect. Missing numeric input yields an input error, and current failure reports include reproduction plus fixed-version evidence. Mobile controls remain usable.
